summary: A student Q&A platform named 'askin' where juniors can post doubts (text/photo) and seniors answer with explanations (notes/video). Features rating system, points/certificates for seniors, and leaderboard. Built with HTML/CSS/JavaScript and Firebase.
architectural_notes: Web-based application using HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Firebase Cloud Storage for image/video/notes uploads
Two user roles: Juniors (ask doubts) and Seniors (answer doubts)
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Hero section illustration showing students collaborating and learning together, warm and welcoming educational theme (hero-students.dim_1200x600.png)
- Icon representing a question or doubt, simple and friendly style (doubt-icon.dim_128x128.png)
- Trophy or medal icon for leaderboard, gold color with celebratory feel (trophy-icon.dim_128x128.png)
- Icon for notes or documents, minimalist educational style (notes-icon.dim_64x64.png)
- Icon for video content, play button with modern styling (video-icon.dim_64x64.png)

existing_features.title: Implement user authentication system with two user roles: Junior (students who post doubts) and Senior (students who answer doubts). Users must be able to sign up and log in using Internet Identity.

Create doubt posting functionality where Juniors can post doubts with a text description and optionally attach a photo. Each doubt should be stored with the author's identity, timestamp, and attachment.

Build an answer/comment section where Seniors can respond to doubts with explanations. Answers should support text content and optionally allow attaching notes (text files) or short video explanations.
Implement a rating system where students can rate answers provided by Seniors. Each answer should display its average rating and students should be able to submit a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
Build a leaderboard page that displays the top Seniors ranked by their earned points. The leaderboard should show rank, name, and total points.

Design a visually engaging and modern frontend with a cohesive educational theme. Use a warm, friendly color palette (avoid blue and purple unless naturally suited) with clear typography optimized for readability. The layout should emphasize content hierarchy with prominent doubt cards, clean answer threads, and intuitive navigation for juniors and seniors.
Render generated images for the homepage hero section, doubt placeholder icons, and leaderboard trophy graphics as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated.

new_feature_requests.summary: Comment/Answer section for seniors to respond
Leaderboard showing top seniors by points
Points and certificates system for seniors
Create a points system where Seniors earn points for providing answers and receiving high ratings. Track cumulative points for each Senior user.
